# FocusPaw

> FocusPaw is a free, open-source, privacy-first Chrome extension that tracks focus-switching habits. It counts visits per domain, draws an interactive radial focus graph, enforces per-site daily limits with a humorous block page, tracks streaks and focus scores, and offers a map view of tracked sites. All data stays in local extension storage — no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

## Site

- [Home](https://focus-paw.luongnv.com/): Product overview, feature list, screenshots, install link
- [Privacy Policy](https://focus-paw.luongnv.com/privacy): Local-only data handling details
